name: SunPad

inputs.description: Your own GMSE01 USA revision 0 disc image. Choose it in SunPad after installing (Game Data > Import or Reimport Game Data); SunPad checks its SHA-256.

tools.name: /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/llvm-config
tools.label: Homebrew LLVM
tools.note: SunPad's engine is compiled with Homebrew's LLVM, whose compiler can load the engine's pointer pass (Apple's cannot). Once: install Homebrew (brew.sh), run brew install llvm in Terminal, then run PadMint again.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform (Command Line Tools alone are not enough). Complete first-launch setup, then select Xcode in Xcode > Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode's iOS platform and select full Xcode in Xcode > Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools, then run PadMint again.

notes: PadMint fetches the pinned engine sources (chrissotraidis/sms-pc-port with the sms-english decompilation), builds libsms_embed.dylib with scripts/build-engine.sh and Homebrew LLVM, and package-ios.sh adds it to the published app and audits the result. The disc is not used by the build: SunPad imports it on the device.

publication.reason: The release publishes the app without the engine. The engine is compiled from decompiled game code on the player's Mac and stays personal.
